explanation: The Feit–Thompson conjecture: there are no distinct primes p, q with (p^q − 1)/(p − 1) dividing (q^p − 1)/(q − 1). The Lean fixes p < q and asks that (q^p − 1)/(q − 1) not divide (p^q − 1)/(p − 1). For p < q (p ≥ 3) this is the smaller-divides-larger direction; the other direction is impossible by size, and for p = 2 by parity (q + 1 is even, 2^q − 1 is odd). So this is equivalent to Wikipedia's symmetric statement. The statement is faithful and open.
